name: search_restaurants
description: Search for restaurants and dining options in a city using OpenTable. Returns a list of available restaurants with reservation links, cuisine types, price ranges, and ratings.

city.description: The city to search restaurants in (e.g., 'New York', 'Paris')

date.description: Date for the reservation in YYYY-MM-DD format

max_price_per_person.description: Maximum price per person in USD (optional)

name: search_events
description: Search for events, concerts, shows, and attractions in a city using Ticketmaster. Returns a list of upcoming events with ticket purchase links, dates, venues, and price ranges.

city.description: The city to search events in

start_date.description: Start date for event search in YYYY-MM-DD format

end_date.description: End date for event search in YYYY-MM-DD format

name: search_attractions
description: Search for tourist attractions, museums, tours, and activities in a city using TripAdvisor. Returns attractions with descriptions, ratings, prices, operating hours, and booking links.

city.description: The city to search attractions in

max_price_per_person.description: Maximum price per person in USD

name: search_hotels
description: Search for hotels and accommodations in a city using Expedia. Returns available hotels with prices, ratings, amenities, and booking links.

city.description: The city to search hotels in

max_price_per_night.description: Maximum price per night in USD

name: get_city_info
description: Get general information about a city including transportation options, neighborhoods, best time to visit, and travel tips using TripAdvisor.

city.description: The city to get information about
